cards.stem: What does the exponential function relate a variable to
options: number of times another variable is used as a multiplier
ratio of the length of the sides of a right triangle
relate the various sides and angles of a triangle
cards.quote: The exponential function relates a variable to the number of times another variable is used as a multiplier
cards.hint: Recall the definition that describes repeated multiplication

cards.stem: How is the logarithmic function described in relation to the exponential function
options: number of times another variable is used as a multiplier
depends only on the value of the angle
cards.quote: The logarithmic function is the inverse of the exponential;
cards.hint: Think about opposite operations that undo each other

cards.stem: Which names are given for the functions that relate triangle sides and angles
cards.quote: The trigonometric functions sine, cosine, and tangent relate the various sides and angles of a triangle.
cards.hint: These three names appear together in the definition

cards.stem: What determines the trigonometric ratio for a right triangle
options: depends only on the value of the angle
depends on the size of the triangle
cards.quote: this ratio depends only on the value of the angle formed by two sides of the triangle and not on the length of any one side.
cards.hint: Focus on what stays constant when triangles are scaled
